verdict.rationale: Neon's own documentation includes a page titled "Connection pooling", which indicates a first-party pooling feature. The evidence pack contains only that title, though, with no detail on how it works or how many connections it handles. missing for 10: evidence that the pooler is built in and managed (no self-run pgbouncer or proxy), documented support for thousands of concurrent connections, configuration and limits detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, a built-in connection pooler handles thousands of concurrent connections without me operating my own pgbouncer or proxy
